To this end NOVA maintains several groups of experts in instrument development, one of these being the NOVA sub-mm instrumentation group, located at the Kapteyn Institute of the University of Groningen. Specifically, the current development is for the Band 2 receivers, sensitive to wavelengths from 67GHz to 116 GHz. Each of these receivers consist of a Warm (WCA) and Cold (CCA) Cartridge Assembly. A total of 73 receivers, each consisting of a WCA and CCA will be built, tested and delivered, under a contract with the European Southern Observatory (ESO). This type of YIG Oscillator is a highly special component, previously developed specifically with for application in astronomical sub-mm receivers. The supplier Micro Lambda Wireless has been involved in this development and has delivered YIG Oscillators for the other receivers previously produced for ALMA. For reasons of commonality, the YIG Oscillators should be of the same type from the same supplier. Our market research has not turned up any potential alternative suppliers.
